a.en: Private parts are the parts of your body covered by your underwear. Their real names are penis and testicles, or vulva, and the bottom. They are private because they belong only to you. If you have a question about them, you can always ask Mummy, Papa or another grown-up you trust.
a.hg: Private parts body ke woh parts hain jo underwear se dhake rehte hain. Inke asli naam hain penis aur testicles, ya vulva, aur bottom. Yeh private isliye hain kyunki yeh sirf tumhare hain. Inke baare mein koi sawaal ho, toh tum Mummy, Papa ya kisi trusted bade se kabhi bhi pooch sakte ho.

q.en: Is it bad to say penis or vulva?
q.hg: Kya penis ya vulva bolna gandi baat hai?

a.en: No. Penis and vulva are correct names, just like nose and knee. They are not rude words. We use them when we need to, for example to tell Mummy, Papa or a doctor that something hurts or itches. We do not use them to tease anyone.
a.hg: Nahi. Penis aur vulva sahi naam hain, jaise naak aur ghutna. Yeh gande words nahi hain. Hum inhe zaroorat padne par bolte hain, jaise Mummy, Papa ya doctor ko batane ke liye ki kahin dard ya khujli ho rahi hai. Hum in words se kisi ko chidhate nahi hain.

q.en: Where does pee come out from in girls? Is it the same hole as periods?
q.hg: Ladkiyon mein pee kahan se nikalta hai? Kya periods bhi usi hole se aate hain?

a.en: No, they are different holes. Pee comes out of the urethra, a very small opening near the front of the vulva. Just behind it is the vaginal opening, where period blood comes out. Behind that is the anus, for stool. So there are three openings, each with its own job. The urethra opening is tiny and hard to see, which is why many people grow up thinking there are only two. After using the toilet, wipe or wash from front to back.
a.hg: Nahi, yeh alag-alag holes hain. Pee urethra se nikalta hai, jo vulva mein aage ki taraf ek bahut chhoti opening hai. Uske theek peeche vaginal opening hai, jahan se period blood nikalta hai. Uske peeche anus hai, potty ke liye. Matlab teen openings hain aur har ek ka apna kaam hai. Urethra ki opening bahut tiny hoti hai aur easily dikhti nahi, isiliye bahut log yahi sochte hue bade hote hain ki sirf do holes hain. Toilet ke baad hamesha aage se peeche ki taraf wipe ya wash karo.

q.en: There is white or clear stuff in my underwear. Is something wrong with me?
q.hg: Meri underwear mein white ya clear sa kuch laga rehta hai. Kya mujhme kuch gadbad hai?

a.en: Usually nothing is wrong. Clear or white fluid from the vagina is called discharge, and it often starts some months before the first period. It is how the vagina cleans itself and stays healthy. It can be thin and stretchy on some days and thicker and creamy on others, and it may dry yellowish on cloth. Wear cotton underwear and change it daily; do not wash inside the vagina. See a doctor if it turns grey, green or lumpy like curd, smells strong, or comes with itching or burning.
a.hg: Usually kuch gadbad nahi hoti. Vagina se nikalne wale clear ya white fluid ko discharge kehte hain, aur yeh aksar pehle period se kuch mahine pehle start ho jata hai. Isi tarah vagina khud ko clean aur healthy rakhti hai. Yeh kisi din patla aur stretchy hota hai, kisi din thick aur creamy, aur kapde par sookhkar halka yellow dikh sakta hai. Cotton underwear pehno aur roz change karo; vagina ke andar wash mat karo. Agar yeh grey, green ya dahi jaisa lumpy ho jaye, strong smell aaye, ya itching ya jalan ho, toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: One of my breasts (or testicles) is bigger than the other. Is that normal?
q.hg: Mera ek breast (ya ek testicle) doosre se bada hai. Kya yeh normal hai?

a.en: Yes. Bodies are not perfectly symmetrical. In puberty one breast often starts growing before the other, and a small difference often remains in adults. A small, firm, tender lump right under the nipple when a breast starts growing is a normal breast bud. Likewise, one testicle is usually a little larger or hangs lower. Neither needs treatment. See a doctor soon for a lump elsewhere in a breast, any lump in a testicle, hot red skin, or an ache that does not go away. Sudden or strong pain or swelling in a testicle is an emergency: tell an adult and go to a hospital straight away, even at night.
a.hg: Haan. Body ke dono sides kabhi perfectly same nahi hote. Puberty mein aksar ek breast doosre se pehle grow karna start karta hai, aur adults mein bhi size ka thoda difference reh jana common hai. Jab breast grow hona start hota hai, tab nipple ke theek neeche ek chhoti, firm, touch karne par dukhne wali lump normal hai; ise breast bud kehte hain. Isi tarah ek testicle usually doosre se thoda bada hota hai ya neeche latakta hai. Dono mein se kisi ke liye treatment nahi chahiye. In cheezon par jaldi doctor ko dikhao: breast mein kisi aur jagah lump, testicle mein koi bhi lump, skin ka red aur garam ho jana, ya aisa dard jo jaata hi na ho. Testicle mein achanak ya tez dard ya swelling emergency hai: turant kisi bade ko batao aur seedha hospital jao, chahe raat hi kyun na ho.

q.en: I am a boy and my chest is getting puffy with a lump under the nipple. Am I turning into a girl?
q.hg: Main ladka hoon aur mera chest puffy ho raha hai, nipple ke neeche lump bhi hai. Kya main ladki ban raha hoon?

a.en: No. This is gynaecomastia, and it happens to a large share of boys during puberty. While hormone levels are still settling, a small disc of breast tissue under one or both nipples can swell and feel tender. You did nothing to cause it, and it says nothing about your gender or sexuality. It usually shrinks by itself within a year or two. See a doctor if it keeps growing, is very painful, leaks fluid, or if you also notice a lump in a testicle. Teasing someone about it is body-shaming.
a.hg: Nahi. Ise gynaecomastia kehte hain, aur puberty mein yeh bahut saare ladkon ke saath hota hai. Jab tak hormone levels settle nahi hote, ek ya dono nipples ke neeche breast tissue ki ek chhoti disc swell ho sakti hai aur touch karne par dukh sakti hai. Yeh tumhari kisi galti se nahi hua, aur iska tumhare gender ya sexuality se koi lena-dena nahi. Usually yeh ek-do saal mein apne aap shrink ho jata hai. Agar yeh badhta hi jaye, bahut dard kare, usme se fluid nikle, ya testicle mein bhi koi lump dikhe, toh doctor ko dikhao. Is baat par kisi ko tease karna body-shaming hai.

q.en: Pee and semen come out of the same tube. Can they mix or come out together?
q.hg: Pee aur semen ek hi tube se nikalte hain. Kya yeh mix ho sakte hain ya ek saath nikal sakte hain?

a.en: In a body with a penis, both leave through the urethra, but not at the same time. Just before ejaculation, a ring of muscle at the outlet of the bladder tightens and shuts the route for urine. That is also why it is hard to urinate with a full erection. A little clear fluid released first, called pre-ejaculate, neutralises traces of urine left in the tube. Semen is not dirty, and urinating afterwards is fine. Burning when you urinate, blood in urine or semen, or discharge from the penis should be checked by a doctor.
a.hg: Jis body mein penis hota hai, usme dono urethra se hi nikalte hain, par ek saath nahi. Ejaculation se theek pehle bladder ke outlet par muscle ka ek ring tight ho jata hai aur urine ka raasta band kar deta hai. Isi wajah se full erection mein pee karna mushkil hota hai. Pehle thoda sa clear fluid nikalta hai, jise pre-ejaculate kehte hain; yeh tube mein bache urine ke traces ko neutralise kar deta hai. Semen ganda nahi hota, aur baad mein pee karna bilkul theek hai. Pee karte time jalan, urine ya semen mein blood, ya penis se discharge ho toh doctor se check karwana chahiye.

q.en: Is my penis too small? What size is normal?
q.hg: Kya mera penis bahut chhota hai? Normal size kya hota hai?

a.en: Almost certainly it is within the normal range, which is wide. The penis and testes grow throughout puberty, often into the late teens, so comparing yourself at 14 or 15 with classmates or adults is misleading. A penis that looks small when soft can lengthen a lot when erect, and looking down at your own gives a foreshortened view. Size has nothing to do with fertility, strength or masculinity. No oil, pill, pump or exercise sold online enlarges it. If there has been no genital growth at all by 14, see a doctor.
a.hg: Almost pakka hai ki woh normal range mein hai, aur yeh range kaafi wide hai. Penis aur testes poori puberty mein grow karte rehte hain, aksar late teens tak, isliye 14-15 ki age mein khud ko classmates ya adults se compare karna misleading hai. Soft state mein chhota dikhne wala penis erection mein kaafi lamba ho sakta hai, aur upar se apna penis dekhne par woh actual se chhota lagta hai. Size ka fertility, taakat ya mardangi se koi connection nahi hai. Online bikne wala koi tel, goli, pump ya exercise ise bada nahi karti. Agar 14 saal tak genitals mein bilkul bhi growth na hui ho, toh doctor ko dikhao.

q.en: My inner labia are long and stick out, and one side is bigger. Is that abnormal?
q.hg: Mere inner labia lambe hain aur bahar nikle rehte hain, aur ek side ka bada hai. Kya yeh abnormal hai?

a.en: No, it is a common and healthy variation. Inner labia (labia minora) grow and often darken during puberty. In many people they are longer than the outer labia, wrinkled, or different on the two sides. The neat, tucked-in look seen in edited images is just one type, not the standard. Labia protect the openings of the urethra and vagina and need no correction. Talk to a doctor only if there is pain, repeated chafing that interferes with cycling or sports, a new lump, a sore, or sudden swelling.
a.hg: Nahi, yeh ek common aur healthy variation hai. Inner labia (labia minora) puberty mein grow karte hain aur aksar unka colour dark ho jata hai. Bahut logon mein yeh outer labia se lambe hote hain, wrinkled hote hain, ya dono side alag-alag hote hain. Edited images mein dikhne wala neat, andar tucked look sirf ek type hai, koi standard nahi. Labia urethra aur vagina ki openings ko protect karte hain aur inhe correct karwane ki zaroorat nahi hoti. Doctor se tabhi baat karo jab dard ho, baar-baar ragad lagne se cycling ya sports mein dikkat ho, nayi lump ya sore dikhe, ya achanak swelling aa jaye.

q.en: Where exactly is the clitoris, and what is it for?
q.hg: Clitoris exactly kahan hota hai, aur iska kaam kya hai?

a.en: The visible tip, the glans, sits at the top of the vulva where the inner labia meet, above the urethral opening, usually partly covered by a small hood of skin. The rest, which is most of it, extends inside the body on both sides of the vaginal opening. It is rich in nerve endings and its function is sensation, including sexual sensation. It is not involved in passing urine, periods or pregnancy. Everyone with a vulva has one, and it varies in size. Pain, persistent itching or a sore there should be seen by a doctor.
a.hg: Iska visible tip, yaani glans, vulva ke top par hota hai jahan inner labia milte hain, urethra ki opening se upar; usually skin ka ek chhota hood ise thoda cover karta hai. Baaki part, jo ki zyadatar part hai, body ke andar vaginal opening ke dono side phaila hota hai. Isme nerve endings bahut zyada hoti hain aur iska function sensation hai, jisme sexual sensation bhi shamil hai. Urine, periods ya pregnancy mein iska koi role nahi hota. Vulva wale har insaan ke paas yeh hota hai, aur iska size alag-alag hota hai. Wahan dard, lagataar itching ya sore ho toh doctor ko dikhana chahiye.

q.en: Can a doctor, a partner or a family tell whether a girl is a virgin?
q.hg: Kya doctor, partner ya family pata laga sakte hain ki ladki virgin hai ya nahi?

a.en: No. There is no physical sign of virginity in any body. The hymen is a stretchy rim of tissue that differs from person to person, changes with growth and activity, and may not tear or bleed at first intercourse, so looking at it or inserting fingers proves nothing. Tightness and bleeding are not evidence either. So-called virginity tests are unscientific, WHO has condemned them, and the Supreme Court of India has prohibited the two-finger test. If someone is pressuring you or a friend into such a test, that is a violation; you can call the Women Helpline 181 or Child Helpline 1098.
a.hg: Nahi. Kisi bhi body mein virginity ka koi physical sign nahi hota. Hymen tissue ki ek stretchy rim hai jo har insaan mein alag hoti hai, growth aur activity ke saath badalti hai, aur first intercourse par zaroori nahi ki tear ho ya bleeding ho; isliye use dekhne ya fingers daalne se kuch prove nahi hota. Tightness ya bleeding bhi koi proof nahi hai. So-called virginity tests unscientific hain, WHO ne inhe condemn kiya hai, aur Supreme Court of India ne two-finger test ko prohibit kiya hai. Agar koi tum par ya tumhari kisi friend par aise test ka pressure daal raha hai, toh yeh violation hai; tum Women Helpline 181 ya Child Helpline 1098 par call kar sakte ho.

q.en: My testicle suddenly started hurting badly. Can I wait and see?
q.hg: Mere testicle mein achanak bahut tez dard start ho gaya hai. Kya main wait karke dekh sakta hoon?

a.en: No, do not wait. Sudden, severe pain in one testicle, often with swelling, nausea or vomiting, or a testicle sitting higher than usual, can be testicular torsion: the cord carrying blood to the testis has twisted. It is most common in teenagers and needs surgery within hours to save the testis. Tell a parent or another adult immediately and go to the nearest hospital emergency department, even at night; call 112 if you cannot get there. Embarrassment is not a reason to delay. Duller aches, a heavy feeling or a painless lump are less urgent but still need a doctor's appointment soon.
a.hg: Nahi, wait mat karo. Ek testicle mein achanak tez dard, aksar swelling, nausea ya vomiting ke saath, ya testicle ka normal se upar chadh jana, testicular torsion ho sakta hai: matlab testis tak blood le jaane wali cord twist ho gayi hai. Yeh teenagers mein sabse common hai aur testis bachane ke liye kuch hi ghanton mein surgery chahiye hoti hai. Turant mummy-papa ya kisi adult ko batao aur nearest hospital ki emergency mein jao, chahe raat hi kyun na ho; agar pahunch na sako toh 112 par call karo. Sharam delay karne ka reason nahi hai. Halka-halka dard, bhaaripan ya painless lump utne urgent nahi hain, par inke liye bhi jaldi doctor ko dikhana zaroori hai.
